qe: What were the ancient people living on the banks of the Narmada river primarily?
qh: नर्मदा नदी के तट पर रहने वाले प्राचीन लोग मुख्य रूप से क्या थे?
e: Narmada nadi ke kinare rehne wale log skilled gatherers the, jinko aas-paas ke jungle ke ped-paudhon aur unke products ki bohot acchi jaankari thi.

qe: In which hills of the North-West did people start growing crops like wheat and barley about 8000 years ago?
qh: उत्तर-पश्चिम की किन पहाड़ियों में लगभग 8000 साल पहले लोगों ने गेहूँ और जौ जैसी फसलें उगाना शुरू किया था?
e: Sulaiman aur Kirthar hills ke area me lagbhag 8000 saal pehle gehun aur jau ugane ke sabse shuruati saboot milte hain.

qe: Which crop was first cultivated to the north of the Vindhya hills?
qh: विंध्य पहाड़ियों के उत्तर में सबसे पहले किस फसल की खेती की गई थी?
e: Vindhya hills ke north wale areas (jaise Koldihwa) me sabse pehle chawal (rice) ugane ke praman mile hain.

qe: On which characters did Mahasweta Devi focus in her work 'Kunti O Nishadi'?
qh: प्रसिद्ध बंगाली लेखिका महाश्वेता देवी ने 'कुंती ओ निषादी' में किन पात्रों पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया?
e: Unhone Mahabharata ki story ko marginalized Nishad community ke perspective se reframe kiya tha.

qe: Who were referred to as 'Heterodox Sects' around 600 BCE?
qh: 600 BCE के दौरान 'हेटेरोडॉक्स सेक्ट्स' (Heterodox Sects) किन्हें कहा गया?
e: Heterodox sects un movements ko kaha gaya jinhone Brahmanical rituals aur rigid orthodox concepts ka virodh kiya, jaise Buddhism aur Jainism.

qe: Which Mandals of the Rigveda are considered the oldest and known as 'Family Books'?
qh: ऋग्वेद के कौन से मंडल सबसे पुराने माने जाते हैं और उन्हें 'फैमिली बुक्स' कहा जाता है?
e: Rigveda ke Mandals 2 se 7 sabse purane hain aur inko rishi parivaron dwara compose kiya gaya tha, isliye inhe Family Books kehte hain.

qe: Which Veda primarily deals with melodies, music, and chanting of hymns?
qh: किस वेद में मुख्य रूप से संगीत और मंत्रों के गायन की चर्चा की गई है?
e: Samaveda ko Indian classical music ki root maana jata hai, jisme Rigvedic hymns ko gaane ke dhang me compose kiya gaya hai.

qe: What is the literal meaning of the word 'Upanishad'?
qh: उपनिषद (Upanishad) शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
e: Upanishad ka literal meaning hota hai guru ke paas baithkar secret ya spiritual gyan prapt karna.

qe: What does the term 'Tirthankara' mean in Jain tradition?
qh: जैन धर्म में 'तीर्थंकर' शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: A spiritual teacher showing path to salvation
e: Tirthankara ka matlab hota hai sansar-sagar ko paar karake moksha ka rasta dikhane wale spiritual guide.

qe: Who was the 24th and last Tirthankara of Jainism?
qh: जैन धर्म के 24वें और अंतिम तीर्थंकर कौन थे?
e: Vardhamana Mahavira Jain dharam ke 24ve aur antim Tirthankara the jinhone isko organize kiya.

qe: Which vow was added by Lord Mahavira to the existing four vows in Jainism?
qh: भगवान महावीर ने जैन धर्म के पाँच व्रतों में कौन सा नया व्रत जोड़ा था?
e: Parshvanatha ke chaar vrato me Mahavira ne paanchva vrat 'Brahmacharya' (celibacy) add kiya tha.

qe: Which sect of Jainism is known for wearing white clothes?
qh: जैन धर्म का कौन सा संप्रदाय सफेद वस्त्र धारण करता है?
e: Shvetambara sect ke followers white clothes pehante hain jabki Digambara tradition me sky-clad (nude) raha jata hai.

qe: Where was Siddhartha (Gautama Buddha) born in 563 BCE?
qh: गौतम बुद्ध का जन्म 563 BCE में कहाँ हुआ था?
e: Gautama Buddha ka birth Nepal ke paas Lumbini namak sthan par hua tha.

qe: Which Buddhist Pitaka contains the collection of Buddha's sermons and dialogues?
qh: बुद्ध के उपदेशों और उनके शिष्यों के बीच हुई बातचीत का संग्रह किस पिटक में है?
e: Sutta Pitaka me Buddha ke mukhya updesh, dialogues aur teachings ka sankalan hai.

qe: In which Buddhist text are the monastic rules of the Sangha compiled?
qh: बुद्ध धर्म के नियमों (संघ के नियमों) का संकलन किस पुस्तक में मिलता है?
e: Vinaya Pitaka me monastics aur Sangha ke anushasan ke rules diye gaye hain.

qe: Where did Gautama Buddha deliver his first sermon (Dharmachakrapravartana)?
qh: बुद्ध ने अपना पहला उपदेश (Dharmachakrapravartana) कहाँ दिया था?
e: Enlightenment pane ke baad Buddha ne apna first sermon Varanasi ke paas Sarnath me diya tha.

qe: What is the primary objective of the 'Eightfold Path' (Ashtangika Marga) in Buddhism?
qh: बुद्ध धर्म के 'अष्टांगिक मार्ग' का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Ashtangika Marga ka maksad dukhon ka ant karke Nirvana prapt karna hai.

qe: Who was the first woman admitted into the Buddhist Sangha as a nun?
qh: बुद्ध संघ में शामिल होने वाली पहली महिला कौन थी?
e: Buddha ki foster mother Mahaprajapati Gotami Sangha me aane wali pehli bhikshuni thi.

qe: In which Indian state is the famous Sanchi Stupa situated?
qh: सांची का स्तूप भारत के किस राज्य में स्थित है?
e: Sanchi Stupa Madhya Pradesh ke Raisen district me Bhopal ke paas situated hai.

qe: Which Begums of Bhopal provided financial aid and resources to preserve the Sanchi Stupa?
qh: भोपाल की किन बेगमों ने सांची के स्तूप को संरक्षित करने में योगदान दिया?
o: Shahjehan Begum and Sultan Jehan Begum
e: Shahjehan Begum aur Sultan Jehan Begum ne Sanchi ke preservation aur museum ke liye funding di thi.

qe: What does the balcony-like structure 'Harmika' represent atop a Buddhist Stupa?
qh: स्तूप में बालकनी जैसी संरचना 'हर्मिका' क्या दर्शाती है?
e: Ande ke upar sthit Harmika ek balcony-like structure hoti hai jise devtaon ka niwas maana jata hai.

qe: What are the stories of Buddha's previous births known as?
qh: बुद्ध के पिछले जन्मों की कहानियों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Jataka tales me Buddha ke pichhle janmo ki kahaniya di gayi hain jo moral sikh deti hain.

qe: Which Buddhist sect started worshipping images of Buddha and Bodhisattvas?
qh: कौन सा बौद्ध संप्रदाय बुद्ध को भगवान मानकर उनकी मूर्ति पूजा करता है?
e: Mahayana Buddhism me Buddha ko divine maankar unki aur Bodhisattvas ki murti puja shuru hui.

qe: Why did the Amravati Stupa get destroyed while the Sanchi Stupa survived intact?
qh: अमरावती का स्तूप क्यों नष्ट हो गया, जबकि सांची का स्तूप बच गया?
o: Lack of timely in-situ protection and looting of sculptures
e: Amravati ko in-situ preserve nahi kiya gaya aur uske pathar-sculptures log nikal kar le gaye, jabki Sanchi ko time par bacha liya gaya.

qe: Which site of the Indus Valley Civilization literally translates to the 'Mound of the Dead'?
qh: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का कौन सा स्थल 'मृतकों का टीला' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Sindhi bhasha me Mohenjo-daro ka exact meaning 'Mound of the Dead' hota hai.

qe: In which Mandal of the Rigveda is the famous Gayatri Mantra composed?
qh: प्रसिद्ध गायत्री मंत्र ऋग्वेद के किस मंडल में संकलित है?
e: Gayatri Mantra Rigveda ke 3rd Mandal me hai jise Maharshi Vishvamitra ne Savitr devta ko samarpit kiya tha.

qe: For how many days did the Kurukshetra war last according to the Mahabharata?
qh: महाभारत का युद्ध कुरुक्षेत्र में कितने दिनों तक चला था?
e: Kauravon aur Pandavon ke beech Kurukshetra ka yuddh 18 dino tak chala tha.

qe: In which language were the core canonical Buddhist texts 'Tripitaka' composed?
qh: प्रसिद्ध बौद्ध ग्रंथ 'त्रिपिटक' किस भाषा में लिखे गए हैं?
e: Shuruati Buddhist Tripitakas ko aam logo ki boli Pali bhasha me compose kiya gaya tha.

qe: Which artifact is considered the most distinctive archaeological hallmark of the Harappan civilization?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की सबसे विशिष्ट पुरावस्तु किसे माना जाता है?
e: Steatite se bani Harappan seals sabse distinctive artifact hain jin par janwaron ke chitra aur undeciphered script milti hai.

qe: Which metal was completely unknown to the people of the Harappan civilization?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के लोग किस धातु का उपयोग नहीं जानते थे?
e: Harappan civilization Bronze Age ki thi; unhe Iron (lohe) ki bilkul jaankari nahi thi.

qe: From which Indus Valley site has the earliest evidence of a ploughed field been discovered?
qh: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता में जूते हुए खेत के साक्ष्य कहाँ से मिले हैं?
e: Rajasthan ke Kalibangan se early Harappan level par ploughed field ke nishan mile hain.

qe: Harappan settlements were primarily divided into which two morphological sections?
qh: हड़प्पाई शहरों को मुख्य रूप से किन दो हिस्सों में विभाजित किया गया था?
e: Zyadatar Harappan shehar do parts me bate the: uncha chhota Citadel (Durg) aur bada Lower Town (Neechla shahar).

qe: Which of the following statements is true regarding the Harappan script?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की लिपि के बारे में क्या सही है?
o: It remains undeciphered to this day
It was written from left to right only
e: Harappan script ek pictographic script thi jisme 375-400 signs hain aur isko aaj tak padha nahi ja saka hai.

qe: Which red-coloured stone was prominently used by Harappans for crafting beads?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता में मनके बनाने के लिए किस लाल रंग के पत्थर का उपयोग किया जाता था?
e: Carnelian ek beautiful laal rang ka stone tha jiska use beading craft me broad level par hota tha.

qe: What specific stone was standardized to manufacture cubical weights in the Harappan civilization?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के बाट मुख्य रूप से किस पत्थर से बनाए जाते थे?
e: Chert naam ke stone se Harappans cubical standardized weights banate the.

qe: At which Harappan site were traces of ancient irrigation canals found?
qh: किस हड़प्पाई स्थल से नहरों के अवशेष मिले हैं?
e: Afghanistan ke Shortughai namak Harappan site se canals ke remnants paye gaye hain.

qe: Where was the 'Great Bath' situated within Mohenjo-daro?
qh: मोहनजोदड़ो में 'विशाल स्नानागार' कहाँ स्थित था?
e: Great Bath Mohenjo-daro ke unche Citadel area par banaya gaya tha jo ritualistic bathing ke liye tha.

qe: What was the standardized dimensional ratio of length, breadth, and thickness of Harappan bricks?
qh: हड़प्पाई ईंटों का लंबाई, चौड़ाई और ऊंचाई का मानक अनुपात क्या था?
e: Harappan bricks ka standard ratio 4:2:1 tha (length 4x, breadth 2x, aur height 1x thi).

qe: Specialized bead-making workshops and factories were discovered at which two Harappan sites?
qh: मनके बनाने के कारखाने किन दो प्रमुख हड़प्पाई स्थलों पर मिले हैं?
e: Chanhudaro aur Lothal specialized centers the jahan se bead-making ke furnaces aur tools mile hain.

qe: What was the primary design feature of the Harappan civic drainage system?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की जल निकास प्रणाली की मुख्य विशेषता क्या थी?
o: Covered drains laid out in a grid pattern
Drains restricted only to palatial complexes
e: Drains aur galiyan grid pattern par bani thi, jisme gharo ki naliyan road ki covered naliyo se judti thi.

qe: Which coastal settlements served as specialized manufacturing centers for shell objects?
qh: शंख से बनी वस्तुओं के उत्पादन के प्रमुख केंद्र कौन से थे?
e: Nageshwar aur Balakot samundar ke kinare the, isliye wahan shankh (shell) se bangles aur inlays banaye jaate the.

qe: In Mesopotamian cuneiform inscriptions, which region is referred to as 'Meluhha'?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लेखों में 'मेलुहा' शब्द का प्रयोग संभवतः किस क्षेत्र के लिए किया गया है?
e: Mesopotamian records me Indus Valley region ko 'Meluhha' (land of seafarers) kaha gaya hai.

qe: Who officially announced the discovery of the Indus Valley Civilization to the world in 1924?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की खोज की घोषणा 1924 में किसने की थी?
e: ASI ke Director-General Sir John Marshall ne 1924 me world ke aage Indus Valley Civilization ki discovery declare ki thi.

qe: How did archaeologists interpret heavily adorned female terracotta figurines from Harappan sites?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता में भारी आभूषणों वाली नारी मूर्तियों को क्या संज्ञा दी गई है?
e: Archaeologists ne aisi terracotta female figures ko fertility aur puja se associate karte hue Mother Goddess maana.

qe: Who proposed the theory that Aryan invasion caused the catastrophic collapse of Harappan cities?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के अंत के लिए 'आर्य आक्रमण' का सिद्धांत किसने दिया था?
e: Mortimer Wheeler ne Rigveda ke 'Purandara' (fort-destroyer) reference ke base par Aryan invasion theory suggest ki thi.

qe: Who is venerated as the 'Father of Indian Archaeology'?
qh: भारतीय पुरातत्व का जनक (Father of Indian Archaeology) किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Alexander Cunningham ASI ke first Director-General the aur unhe Father of Indian Archaeology kaha jata hai.

qe: Why were small pots made of 'Faience' regarded as precious and luxurious in Harappan culture?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता में 'फ़यान्स' से बने पात्रों को कीमती क्यों माना जाता था?
o: Because they were made of real gold
Because they were difficult and complex to manufacture
Because of their colossal storage size
Because they were imported from Rome
e: Faience ko sand, gum aur color mix karke fire karke banaya jata tha, jo ek complex aur mehangi technique thi.

qe: Approximately how many wells were excavated across the urban settlements of Mohenjo-daro?
qh: मोहनजोदड़ो में लगभग कितने कुएं (Wells) मिले हैं?
e: Mohenjo-daro me street aur houses ke andar total milakar lagbhag 700 wells ke traces mile hain.

qe: Which animal motif occurs most predominantly on the seals of the Indus Valley Civilization?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की मुहरों पर किस जानवर का चित्र सबसे अधिक मिलता है?
e: Harappan seals par mythical one-horned animal (Unicorn) ka depiction sabse frequent milta hai.

qe: What is the primary objective of studying 'Stratigraphy' in archaeological excavations?
qh: पुरातत्व में 'स्तरविन्यास' (Stratigraphy) का क्या उपयोग है?
o: Understanding the relative chronological sequence of cultural layers
e: Mound excavation me mitti ki parato (strata) ka study karne se artifacts ki relative chronology aur age samajh aati hai.

qe: At which Harappan site was an artificial brick-built tidal dockyard unearthed?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता का 'गोदीबाड़ा' (Dockyard) कहाँ मिला है?
e: Gujarat ke Lothal me Sabarmati ki tributary Bhogavo nadi ke paas tidal dockyard mila hai.

qe: In which direction was the Harappan script commonly inscribed?
qh: हड़प्पाई लिपि को किस दिशा में लिखा जाता था?
e: Right side wide spacing aur left side cramped signs se pata chalta hai ki Harappan script right-to-left likhi jaati thi.

qe: Around which timeframe did the widespread decline and abandonment of Mature Harappan sites begin?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता का विनाश लगभग किस वर्ष के बाद शुरू हुआ?
e: Lagbhag 1900 BCE ke aaspas distinctive urban traits (seals, standardized weights) khatam hone lage the.

qe: In which century did the Aztecs migrate and establish their civilization in Central Mexico?
qh: मध्य मेक्सिको की प्रसिद्ध 'एज़्टेक' (Aztec) सभ्यता की स्थापना लगभग किस शताब्दी में हुई थी?
e: Aztecs 12th century me north se central Mexican valley me aaye aur aage chalkar empire build kiya.

qe: The name of the country 'Mexico' was derived from which Aztec patron deity?
qh: मेक्सिको (Mexico) देश का नाम एज़्टेक के किस देवता के नाम पर पड़ा है?
e: Aztecs ke war god 'Mextli' ke naam se modern Mexico word derive hua hai.

qe: What was the capital of the Aztec Empire, built on reclaimed land in Lake Texcoco?
qh: एज़्टेक सभ्यता की राजधानी का नाम क्या था, जिसे झील को सुखाकर बनाया गया था?
e: Tenochtitlan Aztec empire ki capital thi jise Lake Texcoco ke beech me channels aur causeways ke sath banaya gaya tha.

qe: What were the agricultural 'Chinampas' constructed by the Aztecs?
qh: एज़्टेक लोगों द्वारा बनाई गई 'चिनाम्पा' (Chinampas) क्या थीं?
e: Chinampas lake surface par mud aur reeds se banaye gaye artificial floating islands the jin par intensive farming hoti thi.

qe: Which celestial entity held the supreme religious significance in Aztec society?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में सबसे महत्वपूर्ण देवता कौन थे?
e: Aztecs Sun God ko universe ka center maante the aur unko energy dene ke liye human sacrifices karte the.

qe: What was the function of 'Calmecac' schools in Aztec society?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में बच्चों के लिए 'कालमेकाक' (Calmecac) नामक संस्थान किस उद्देश्य के लिए थे?
o: Religious and military training for noble youths
e: Calmecac elite noble class ke ladko ke schools the jahan unhe religion, law aur military leadership sikhayi jaati thi.

qe: Who were the 'Pochteca' in the socio-economic structure of the Aztecs?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में 'पोचतेका' (Pochteca) किन्हें कहा जाता था?
e: Pochteca specialized elite merchants the jo long-distance foreign trade ke sath-sath state ke liye spies ka kaam karte the.

qe: In which geographic region of Central America did the Maya civilization primarily blossom?
qh: माया सभ्यता (Maya Civilization) मुख्य रूप से मेक्सिको के किस हिस्से में विकसित हुई थी?
e: Maya civilization Yucatan Peninsula aur uske adjacent Central American rain forests me phali-phooli.

qe: Which scientific fields represented the crowning intellectual achievements of the Mayas?
qh: माया सभ्यता की सबसे बड़ी उपलब्धि किस क्षेत्र में मानी जाती है?
e: Mayans complex astronomical observations, zero-inclusive math aur precise solar calendar systems ke liye famous the.

qe: Around which century did the Inca civilization begin its imperial rise in Peru?
qh: दक्षिण अमेरिका के पेरू में 'इंका' (Inca) सभ्यता का उदय किस शताब्दी में हुआ था?
e: 12th century me Manco Capac ne Cuzco valley me Inca civilization ki neenv rakhi thi.

qe: What was the capital city of the Inca Empire located high in the Andes?
qh: इंका साम्राज्य की राजधानी क्या थी?
e: Cuzco Inca empire ka administrative, military aur religious capital tha.

qe: Which ingenious knotted-cord recording system was utilized by the Incas for numerical accounting?
qh: इंका लोग डेटा रिकॉर्ड करने और संदेश भेजने के लिए धागों की गांठों वाली किस प्रणाली का उपयोग करते थे?
e: Quipu colored string cords me bandhi knots ka ek system tha jisse Incas census aur tax records maintain karte the.

qe: Who is traditionally revered as the founding monarch of the Inca dynasty?
qh: इंका साम्राज्य के पहले शासक कौन थे जिन्होंने साम्राज्य विस्तार की नींव रखी?
e: Manco Capac ko Inca tradition me empire ka mythical first king aur founder maana jata hai.

qe: What was the mandatory communal labour tax system called in the Inca Empire?
qh: इंका समाज में 'मिटा' (Mita) प्रणाली का क्या अर्थ था?
e: Mita ek mandatory public labour system tha jisme common citizens roads, bridges aur state fields par kaam karte the.

qe: Which European colonial power led the military conquest and downfall of both the Aztec and Inca empires?
qh: 16वीं शताब्दी में एज़्टेक और इंका साम्राज्यों का विनाश किसके आक्रमण के कारण हुआ था?
e: Spanish conquistadors (Cortes ne Aztecs ko aur Pizarro ne Incas ko) ne 16th century me destroy kiya.

qe: The position of an Aztec agricultural serf resembled which social class of medieval Europe?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में 'सर्फ' (Serf) की स्थिति यूरोप के किस वर्ग के समान थी?
e: Aztec serfs noble estates se tied hote the aur agricultural labour provide karte the, jaise European serfs.

qe: Which agricultural method did the Incas engineer to cultivate steep Andean slopes?
qh: इंका लोग खेती के लिए एंडीज पर्वतों पर किस तकनीक का उपयोग करते थे?
e: Andes ke steep pahado par soil erosion rokne aur farming ke liye Incas ne stone-walled Terraced fields banayi thi.

qe: What was the nature of the written script used by the Aztecs?
qh: एज़्टेक सभ्यता में 'पिक्टोग्राफिक' लिपि का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Pictographic glyphs representing events and sounds
e: Aztecs pictographic aur ideographic glyphs ke zariye codices me apni history aur administrative records depict karte the.

qe: What architectural stone monuments characterized major Mayan ceremonial centers like Tikal?
qh: माया सभ्यता में निर्मित विशाल पत्थर की संरचनाओं को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Mayans ne ceremonial aur astronomical purposes ke liye steep-stepped stone Pyramids banaye the.

qe: What was the social standing of military warriors in the Aztec Empire?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में 'योद्धाओं' का दर्जा कैसा था?
e: Aztec society highly militaristic thi; successful warriors (Jaguar aur Eagle warriors) ko high prestige aur land milta tha.

qe: Who authored the monumental encyclopedic work 'Natural History' (Naturalis Historia) during the Roman era?
qh: 1800 साल पहले लिखी गई प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'प्राकृतिक इतिहास' (Natural History) के लेखक कौन थे?
e: Roman scholar Pliny the Elder ne 1st century CE me famous encyclopedia 'Natural History' likhi thi.

qe: Across which three continents was the Roman Empire geographically spread at its peak?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य का विस्तार किन तीन महाद्वीपों में था?
e: Roman Empire Europe, North Africa aur West Asia ke pure Mediterranean perimeter me phaila hua tha.

qe: Which body of water was metaphorically described as the 'Heart of the Roman Empire'?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य का हृदय किसे कहा जाता था?
e: Mediterranean Sea Roman empire ke center me tha aur empire ki connectivity aur trade ka main lifeline tha.

qe: Which two European rivers marked the fortified northern frontiers of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य की उत्तरी सीमा कौन सी नदियाँ बनाती थीं?
e: Rhine aur Danube rivers Roman empire ki northern natural boundary banati thi jo use Germanic tribes se alag karti thi.

qe: Which geographical desert formed the southern natural boundary of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य की दक्षिणी सीमा पर कौन सा विशाल मरुस्थल था?
e: North Africa me Sahara Desert Roman empire ki southern limit ko define karta tha.

qe: Who established the Roman Principate and reigned as the first Roman Emperor in 27 BCE?
qh: प्रथम रोमन सम्राट कौन था जिसने 27 ईसा पूर्व में शासन संभाला?
e: Augustus (Octavian) ne 27 BCE me Republic ko replace karke first Roman imperial regime (Principate) banaya.

qe: What modest title meaning 'leading citizen' did Augustus officially adopt to appease the Senate?
qh: अगस्तस ने स्वयं को किस नाम से पुकारना पसंद किया?
e: Augustus ne monarchical title lene ke bajay 'Princeps' (leading citizen) kehna pasand kiya taaki Senate insult feel na kare.

qe: What were the three foundational political pillars of the Roman governance system?
qh: रोमन राजनीतिक व्यवस्था के तीन मुख्य स्तंभ कौन से थे?
e: Roman state ka political power balance Emperor, Senate (aristocracy) aur paid professional Army ke beech divided tha.

qe: What crucial structural feature distinguished the Roman army from that of the rival Persian (Iranian) Empire?
qh: रोमन सेना की प्रमुख विशेषता क्या थी, जो उसे ईरान से अलग करती थी?
o: It relied purely on seasonal peasant levies
It was a standing, professional, salaried army
e: Rome ke paas regular salaried professional standing army thi jisme soldiers ko 25 years minimum service deni padti thi.

qe: Which social class dominated the membership of the Roman Senate?
qh: रोम में 'सीनेट' (Senate) मुख्य रूप से किन लोगों की संस्था थी?
e: Senate me Roman world ke sabse wealthy landed families aur elite patricians ka representation hota tha.

qe: How is the historical reign of Emperor Augustus uniquely remembered in Roman annals?
qh: अगस्तस के शासनकाल को रोमन इतिहास में किस रूप में याद किया जाता है?
e: Civil wars ke baad Augustus ka rule internal stability aur peace laya, jise Pax Romana (Roman Peace) kehte hain.

qe: Which specific ceramic containers were manufactured to transport wine and olive oil across Rome?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में तरल पदार्थों (वाइन, तेल) के परिवहन के लिए किन मटकों का उपयोग किया जाता था?
e: Liquid commodities jaise wine aur oil ko do-handle wale ceramic jars me transport karte the jinhe Amphorae kehte hain.

qe: How was the 'Nuclear Family' structure typical in Roman civil society?
qh: रोमन समाज में 'एकल परिवार' (Nuclear Family) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Adult sons living apart from their parents' household
e: Roman society me adult married sons apne parents ke sath nahi rehte the, aur nuclear family structure predominant tha.

qe: What was the institutional status of 'Slavery' within the economic fabric of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में 'दासता' (Slavery) की स्थिति क्या थी?
o: A deeply entrenched economic institution and capital investment
e: Rome me slavery ek deep-rooted economic institution thi jahan slaves ko agriculture, mines aur trade me capital investment maana jata tha.

qe: Which pure gold coin was introduced by Emperor Constantine that became a stable standard currency?
qh: रोम के सम्राट कांसटेनटाइन ने कौन सा नया सोने का सिक्का चलाया था?
e: Constantine ne 4.5 grams pure gold ka coin 'Solidus' introduce kiya jo sadiyon tak stable currency bana raha.

qe: Which city was founded by Constantine as the new eastern administrative capital of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य की दूसरी राजधानी कौन सी बनाई गई थी?
e: Constantine ne Byzantium ke sthan par Constantinople (modern Istanbul) ko new imperial capital banaya.

qe: Which groups invaded and breached the northern frontiers during the Third Century Crisis in Rome?
qh: तीसरी शताब्दी के संकट के दौरान रोम पर आक्रमण करने वाले कबीलों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: 3rd century CE me Rhine aur Danube frontiers par Goths, Alamanni aur Franks jaise Germanic tribes ne repeated attacks kiye.

qe: Which statement accurately describes the literacy pattern across the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में साक्षरता की दर के बारे में क्या सही है?
o: Universal full literacy across all provinces
Casual literacy that varied sharply across regions and classes
Literacy was strictly forbidden for women
Only the imperial family could read
e: Literacy har province aur class me alag thi; military camps aur Pompeii jaise urban towns me high casual literacy ke proofs milte hain.

qe: What archaeological evidence proves widespread casual literacy among ordinary citizens in Pompeii?
qh: पोम्पेई (Pompeii) शहर में साक्षरता का प्रमाण कहाँ मिलता है?
o: Graffiti, trade advertisements, and notices painted on street walls
e: Pompeii ke city walls par election advertisements, personal graffiti aur price lists milti hain jo common literacy prove karti hain.

qe: What were the two primary administrative and literary languages of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य की दो आधिकारिक प्रशासनिक भाषाएँ कौन सी थीं?
e: Western empire me Latin language dominate karti thi jabki Eastern Mediterranean provinces me Greek language administration ki bhasha thi.

qe: Thousands of surviving bureaucratic documents from Roman Egypt written on reeds are called:
qh: मिस्र (Egypt) से प्राप्त वे दस्तावेज़ जो 'पपायरस' पर लिखे गए थे, उन्हें क्या कहते हैं?
e: Papyrus plant ke fibers se bane sheets par likhe gaye letters aur legal contracts ko Papyri kehte hain.

qe: What property rights did women legally retain under classical Roman law?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में महिलाओं को किस प्रकार के कानूनी अधिकार प्राप्त थे?
o: Zero rights with complete forfeiture to husbands
Retained ownership of natal property and legal rights to manage independent estates
Right to serve in the imperial legions
e: Roman women marriage ke baad bhi apne father ki property ki legal heir rehti thi aur independent property manage kar sakti thi.

qe: How did marriage and divorce laws function in Roman civil society?
qh: रोम में 'तलाक' (Divorce) लेना कैसा था?
o: Relatively easy, requiring only a formal notice of intent from either spouse
Required direct approval from the Emperor
Subjected spouses to heavy criminal penalties
e: Roman law me divorce lena aasan tha; husband ya wife me se koi bhi notice of intent dekar marriage dissolve kar sakta tha.

qe: Which Sasanian monarch of Iran claimed to have annihilated a Roman army of 60,000 soldiers?
qh: ईरान के ससानी वंश के किस राजा ने 60,000 रोमन सेना को हराने का दावा किया था?
e: Sasanian king Shapur I ne 3rd century me Roman forces ko buri tarah defeat karke Antioch capture karne ka claim kiya tha.

qe: What major territorial policy was implemented by Emperor Diocletian to stabilize the Roman Empire?
qh: सम्राट डायोक्लेशियन (Diocletian) ने साम्राज्य को बचाने के लिए क्या प्रमुख सुधार किया?
o: Cut losses by abandoning territories of minimal strategic and economic value
e: Diocletian ne empire ko manageable banane ke liye un frontiers ko abandon kiya jo revenue nahi dete the aur borders ko fortify kiya.

qe: What did the ubiquitous 'Public Baths' represent in Roman urban culture?
qh: रोम में 'सार्वजनिक स्नानगृह' (Public Baths) किसका प्रतीक थे?
o: Hallmark of sophisticated civic urban lifestyle and social leisure
e: Public baths Roman city life ka sabse distinctive cultural recreation feature the jo civic identity represent karte the.

qe: What was the enduring political significance of the established tradition of Roman Civil Law?
qh: रोमन कानून की परंपरा (Roman Law) का मुख्य महत्व क्या था?
o: It exclusively served the interest of the plebeians
It acted as a constitutional check against arbitrary imperial despotism
It was completely abolished during Late Antiquity
e: Roman legal tradition itni strong thi ki wo autocrat emperors ko bhi rule of law ke tahat bound rakhti thi.

qe: Which Roman Emperor officially converted to Christianity and provided it with state patronage?
qh: सम्राट कांसटेनटाइन ने किस धर्म को आधिकारिक संरक्षण दिया?
e: Constantine ne 4th century CE me Christianity ko adopt kiya aur use imperial state patronage provide kiya.

qe: In the context of the Late Roman Empire, who were designated as 'Pagans'?
qh: रोमन समाज में 'पेगन' (Pagan) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: Non-Christian followers of polytheistic traditional religions
e: Christianity spread hone ke baad un traditional polytheist logo ko 'Pagan' kaha gaya jo purane devtaon ki puja karte the.

qe: Which lost western territories did Emperor Justinian attempt to reconquer in the 6th century?
qh: जस्टिनियन (Justinian) ने साम्राज्य के किस हिस्से को वापस जीतने का प्रयास किया था?
e: 6th century me Byzantine Emperor Justinian ne Vandals aur Ostrogoths se North Africa aur Italy recapture karne ki koshish ki.

qe: What external geopolitical pressure directly accelerated the fragmentation of the Western Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य के पतन का एक मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: Repeated incursions and settlements by Germanic and Central Asian confederations
Drying up of the Nile river
e: Germanic tribes (Visigoths, Vandals) aur Huns ke continuous pressure ne Western Roman Empire ko disintegrate kar diya.

qe: Which 7th-century geopolitical revolution permanently dismantled Roman hegemony in the Near East and North Africa?
qh: सातवीं शताब्दी में किस नए राजनीतिक और धार्मिक उदय ने रोमन साम्राज्य को अंतिम रूप से प्रभावित किया?
e: 7th century me Arabian Peninsula se Islamic Caliphate ke rise ne Roman (Byzantine) empire ke eastern provinces capture kar liye.

qe: Which period in Roman imperial history is categorized as the 'Early Empire'?
qh: रोमन इतिहास में 'अर्ली एम्पायर' (Early Empire) किस काल को कहा जाता है?
o: From Augustus to the 3rd century CE
From the 4th to the 7th century CE
The reign of Julius Caesar alone
The era following the Arab conquests
e: 27 BCE me Augustus ke rule se lekar 3rd century crisis tak ke era ko Early Empire maana jata hai.

qe: Why did the Late Roman Empire transition its currency base from silver to gold?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में 'सिल्वर बेस्ट' करेंसी के स्थान पर 'गोल्ड बेस्ट' करेंसी क्यों लाई गई?
e: Spain ki silver mines exhaust hone ki wajah se silver denarius debase ho gaya tha, isliye Constantine ne gold Solidus ko base banaya.

qe: What was the estimated annual estate income enjoyed by the grand senatorial families in Late Rome?
qh: रोमन अभिजात वर्ग (Aristocracy) की वार्षिक आय कितनी बताई गई है?
e: Historian Olympiodorus ke mutabik richest senatorial families ko unke huge estates se yearly 4,000 lbs gold tak revenue milta tha.

qe: Who constituted the 'Equites' (Knights) class in Roman society?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में 'नाइट्स' (Knights) या अश्वारोही वर्ग कौन थे?
o: Wealthy equestrian landowners, business entrepreneurs, and bankers
e: Equites (Knights) senators ke baad doosra wealthy aristocracy group tha jo business, trade aur tax-farming me involved tha.

qe: What practice was commonly used by Roman estate owners to control and identify manual workers and slaves?
qh: रोम में 'मज़दूरों' पर नियंत्रण रखने के लिए सम्राटों और स्वामियों ने क्या किया था?
e: Estates aur factories me runaway slaves aur workers ko identify karne ke liye unpar hot iron se branding ki jaati thi.

qe: The historical era spanning from the 4th to the 7th centuries CE in the Roman world is designated as:
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में 'लेट एंटीक्विटी' (Late Antiquity) का काल कौन सा है?
e: Constantine ke rise se lekar Islamic conquest tak (4th se 7th century CE) ke period ko Late Antiquity bolte hain.

qe: Which specific standardized amphora container was utilized to export Spanish olive oil across the Roman world?
qh: स्पेनिश ऑलिव ऑयल (जैतून का तेल) किन बर्तनों में ले जाया जाता था?
e: Spanish olive oil predominantly 'Dressel 20' type heavy globular amphorae me transport hota tha jiske shards Monte Testaccio par mile hain.

qe: Why did Emperor Gallienus exclude senators from holding high military commands?
qh: रोमन सम्राट 'गैलिएनस' (Gallienus) ने सीनेटर्स को सेना से क्यों हटाया?
o: To prevent senatorial coups and consolidate direct imperial control over the army
e: Gallienus ne senators ko command se baahar kar diya taaki senatorial aristocracy army ko use karke throne capture na kar sake.

qe: Who were classified under the legal category of 'Humiliores' in the Roman social order?
qh: रोमन समाज में 'निम्नतर वर्ग' (Humiliores) में कौन शामिल थे?
o: Rural tenant labourers, wage earners, and the urban poor
e: Roman legal system me elite honestiores ke opposite lower working class, peasants aur poor citizens ko Humiliores kaha jata tha.

qe: The word 'Mesopotamia' is synthesized from which two Greek root words?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया शब्द किन दो ग्रीक शब्दों से मिलकर बना है?
e: Greek language me 'Mesos' ka matlab middle (beech) aur 'Potamos' ka matlab river hota hai (do nadiyo ke beech ki zameen).

qe: Between which two legendary rivers did the Mesopotamian civilization flourish?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की सभ्यता किन दो नदियों के बीच विकसित हुई थी?
e: Mesopotamia modern Iraq me Tigris (Dajla) aur Euphrates (Furat) nadiyo ke beech ka fertile alluvial land tha.

qe: What physical material served as the medium for writing in ancient Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में लेखन कला की शुरुआत के लिए लोग किस सामग्री का उपयोग करते थे?
e: Mesopotamians gili mitti (clay) ki tablets par reed stylus se wedge-shaped signs banate the aur dhoop me sukha kar bake karte the.

qe: Which is recognized as the earliest recorded language of Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की सबसे पुरानी ज्ञात भाषा कौन सी थी?
e: Mesopotamia me sabse pehle likhi jaane wali bhasha Sumerian thi, jise baad me Akkadian ne replace kiya.

qe: What was the wedge-shaped script developed in ancient Mesopotamia called?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की लिपि को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Latin word 'Cuneus' (wedge) se Cuneiform bana hai, jiska matlab keel ya khunti ke aakar ke signs wali script hota hai.

qe: What scientific branch was highly advanced in Mesopotamia, marked by astronomical solar and lunar observations?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लोग आकाश में तारों और ग्रहों की स्थिति का अध्ययन करते थे, इसे क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Mesopotamians ne solar/lunar eclipses aur planetary movements ka systematic record rakha, jo Astronomy me landmark bana.

qe: What were the monumental stepped temple towers called in ancient Mesopotamian cities?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के मंदिरों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Mesopotamian city ke patron god ke unche stepped terrace-like mud brick temple structure ko Ziggurat bolte the.

qe: The ancient southern city of Ur was dedicated to the worship of which patron deity?
qh: उर (Ur) शहर मेसोपोटामिया के किस देवता को समर्पित था?
e: Ur south Mesopotamia ka major city-state tha jo Moon God (Nanna/Sin) ko dedicate kiya gaya tha.

qe: Inanna was revered as the Mesopotamian goddess of which two domains?
qh: इन्नाना (Inanna) मेसोपोटामिया में किसकी देवी मानी जाती थी?
e: Uruk me Inanna ko Love aur War ki supreme goddess ke roop me pooja jata tha.

qe: At which Mesopotamian urban center was the sculpted marble 'Warka Head' discovered?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में 'वारका शीर्ष' (Warka Head) कहाँ से मिला है?
e: Pure white marble se carve kiya gaya famous female face sculpture 'Warka Head' Uruk city se discover hua tha.

qe: Which Mesopotamian city-state on the Euphrates prospered primarily as a strategic commercial trading hub?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया का वह कौन सा शहर था जो केवल व्यापारिक गतिविधियों के लिए प्रसिद्ध था?
e: Mari Euphrates ke trade route par transit center tha jo timber, copper, tin aur wine ke commercial trade se rich bana.

qe: What was the normative family structure documented in Mesopotamian civil law tablets?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के समाज में किस प्रकार के परिवार का चलन था?
e: Mesopotamian legal records show karte hain ki wahan married couple aur unke bachhon wali Nuclear family standard maani jaati thi.

qe: In which civilization was the heroic 12-tablet 'Epic of Gilgamesh' composed?
qh: गिलगमेश (Gilgamesh) महाकाव्य की रचना किस सभ्यता में हुई थी?
e: Uruk ke legendary ruler Gilgamesh ki immortality search par based Epic of Gilgamesh Mesopotamia ka master literary work hai.

qe: Which Assyrian king established a celebrated royal library of cuneiform tablets at Nineveh?
qh: निनवे (Nineveh) में एक विशाल पुस्तकालय की स्थापना किस राजा ने की थी?
e: Assyrian king Assurbanipal ne Nineveh me thousands of cuneiform literary aur scientific tablets collect karke grand library banayi.

qe: What sexagesimal base did Mesopotamians invent to divide one hour into minutes and a circle into degrees?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में समय गणना के लिए 1 घंटे को कितने मिनटों में बांटा गया था?
e: Mesopotamians ne base-60 sexagesimal math system diya jisse 1 hour = 60 mins aur circle = 360° ka division define hua.

qe: Why did agrarian populations situated downstream along the Euphrates frequently suffer water shortages?
qh: फरात नदी के 'डाउनस्ट्रीम' (निचले हिस्से) के लोगों को पानी की समस्या क्यों होती थी?
o: Upstream communities diverted too much water into their own field channels
e: Upstream settlements zyada irrigation ke liye channels se paani divert kar lete the, jisse downstream wale logo ko water scarcity hoti thi.

qe: Which Mesopotamian city excavated by Sir Leonard Woolley was notorious for narrow, winding, unpaved streets?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के किस शहर की गलियां बहुत संकरी और टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी पाई गई हैं?
e: Ur city me roads narrow, unpaved aur winding thi jisse wheeled carts ghar tak nahi ja sakti thi aur pack animals use hote the.

qe: What physical geometric shape was characteristic of Mesopotamian stone rolling seals?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की सील (Mohar) का आकार कैसा होता था?
e: Mesopotamians cylindrical stone seals banate the jinko gili mitti ki tablet par roll karke continuous impression stamp kiya jata tha.

qe: What represents the most enduring scientific contribution of Mesopotamia to the discipline of mathematics?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया का गणित के क्षेत्र में सबसे बड़ा योगदान क्या माना जाता है?
o: Compilation of multiplication, square, square root, and compound interest tables
e: Mesopotamians ne clay tablets par complex multiplication tables, squares, square roots aur compound interest ke tables banaye the.

qe: The ruling kings of the trade-centric city-state of Mari belonged to which ethnic community?
qh: मारी के राजा किस समुदाय से संबंधित थे?
e: Mari ke kings Amorite pastoral nomadic background se the aur unke culture me pastoral aur agrarian traits combine the.

qe: What economic activity was predominantly carried out in the arid Steppe grasslands of Northern Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में स्टेपी (Steppe) क्षेत्र का मुख्य उपयोग क्या था?
e: North Mesopotamia ke Steppe grasslands me sheep aur goats ki pastoral herding hi primary livelihood ka resource thi.

qe: According to ancient Sumerian epic poetry, King Enmerkar dispatched his messenger to which mountain city for lapis lazuli?
qh: राजा एनमर्कर ने अपने दूत को किस शहर के पास कीमती पत्थर लेने भेजा था?
e: Uruk ke ruler Enmerkar ne Lapis Lazuli aur silver obtain karne ke liye apne messenger ko Aratta city bheja tha.

qe: Which metal alloy defined the early urban technology and tools of Mesopotamian civilization?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लोग किस धातु का उपयोग औजार बनाने के लिए करने लगे थे?
e: Mesopotamia Bronze Age society thi jahan Copper aur Tin ko melt karke hard Bronze alloy tools banaye jaate the.

qe: What was the subject matter recorded on the 'Omen Tablets' of Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में 'ओमेन टैबलेट' (Omen Tablet) का संबंध किससे था?
o: Superstitious omens, architectural beliefs, and astrological portents
e: Omen tablets par daily life ke shagun, ghar ke door directions aur animal behavior ke superstitious signs likhe hote the.

qe: The grand royal palace of King Zimri-Lim was famously situated in which prosperous city-state?
qh: जिम्री-लिम (Zimri-Lim) का महल मेसोपोटामिया के किस शहर में स्थित था?
e: Mari ke king Zimri-Lim ka palace ancient world me architectural marvel tha jise dekhne door-door ke rulers aate the.

qe: In historical sociolinguistics, 'Division of Labour' is regarded as the defining hallmark of what?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में 'श्रम विभाजन' (Division of Labour) किसका मुख्य लक्षण है?
e: Division of labour urban society ka core feature hota hai jahan trade, craft, manufacture aur services ek dusre par depend karti hain.

qe: Beyond trade accounts, for what institutional purpose were cuneiform dictionaries and writing employed?
qh: लेखन कला के विकास के बाद मेसोपोटामिया में डिक्शनरी (शब्दकोश) का उपयोग किस लिए होता था?
o: Providing legal validity to contracts and codifying imperial laws
e: Writing ka main objective property transactions, deeds, legal decisions aur royal laws ko permanent legal validity dena tha.

qe: From which regions did Mesopotamia import coveted raw minerals like lapis lazuli, copper, and timber?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लोग 'लापिस लाजुली' पत्थर कहाँ से मंगाते थे?
e: Mesopotamia me stones aur metals nahi the, isliye wo agriculture surplus export karke Turkey, Iran aur Gulf se minerals mangwate the.

qe: Around which historical millennium did cuneiform script and tablet writing mature in Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में 'कीलाक्षर' लिपि का विकास लगभग कब हुआ था?
e: Lagbhag 2600 BCE tak Cuneiform script aur Sumerian written language administrative records ke liye fully develop ho chuki thi.

qe: In which geographical sector of Mesopotamia did urban civilization and monumental temples first emerge?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के किस क्षेत्र में सबसे पहले शहरीकरण शुरू हुआ?
e: South Mesopotamia (Sumer) ka irrigated alluvial desert basin wo jagah thi jahan first cities aur temples develop hue.

qe: Around 2400 BCE, which Semitic language gradually superseded Sumerian as the dominant spoken tongue?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की सभ्यता में 'अक्कादी' भाषा ने किसका स्थान लिया था?
e: 2400 BCE ke around Akkadian language ne Sumerian ko spoken language ke form me replace kar diya.

qe: What represented the cheapest and most energy-efficient mode of freight transport in ancient Mesopotamia?
qh: प्राचीन मेसोपोटामिया में परिवहन का सबसे सस्ता और आसान तरीका क्या था?
e: Nadiyo aur canals ke zariye boats se bulk goods transport karna cheapest tha kyunki isme animal feed ka cost nahi lagta tha.

qe: The majestic city of Nineveh served as the imperial capital of which militaristic empire?
qh: निनवे (Nineveh) शहर किस साम्राज्य की राजधानी थी?
e: Nineveh northern Assyrian empire ki imperial capital thi jahan king Assurbanipal ne grand library establish ki thi.

qe: Based on lunar cycles, into how many months did Mesopotamian astronomers divide the calendar year?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लोग साल को कितने महीनों में बांटते थे?
e: Moon phases ke basis par unhone saal ko 12 lunar months aur month ko 4 weeks me standardize kiya tha.

qe: Sargon was the legendary empire-builder and monarch of which Mesopotamian dynasty?
qh: सार्गोन (Sargon) किस समुदाय का प्रसिद्ध राजा था?
e: Sargon of Akkad ne world ka pehla territorial Akkadian empire establish kiya tha around 2334 BCE.

qe: In biological anthropology, what does the taxonomic designation 'Homo sapiens' literally mean?
qh: मानव विकास के क्रम में 'होमो सेपियंस' (Homo Sapiens) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Latin me 'Homo' ka matlab man aur 'Sapiens' ka matlab wise ya thinking hota hai; modern humans isi category me aate hain.

qe: Which extinct hominin species is credited with the earliest manufacture of flaked stone tools?
qh: सबसे पहले पत्थर के औजार बनाने वाले मानव को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Homo habilis ko 'handy man' ya tool maker kaha jata hai jinhone sabse pehle Oldowan pebble stone tools banaye.

qe: Which hominin species was the first to exhibit habitual bipedalism and walk fully upright?
qh: दो पैरों पर सीधे खड़े होकर चलने वाले पहले मानव को क्या कहा गया?
e: Homo erectus wo species thi jo poori tarah do pairo par sidhi khadi hokar walk aur run kar sakti thi.

qe: In which European country were the fossil remains of the 'Neanderthal' human first discovered in 1856?
qh: प्रसिद्ध 'निएंडरथल' (Neanderthal) मानव के अवशेष सबसे पहले किस देश में मिले थे?
e: Germany ki Neander valley me 1856 me quarry workers ko sabse pehle Neanderthal fossils mile the.

qe: Which naturalist published 'On the Origin of Species' in 1859, founding the modern theory of evolution?
qh: किस वैज्ञानिक ने 'ऑन द ओरिजिन ऑफ स्पीशीज' पुस्तक लिखकर मानव विकास के सिद्धांत को स्थापित किया?
e: Charles Darwin ne 1859 me 'On the Origin of Species' publish karke natural selection ka evolutionary concept diya.

qe: In mammalian taxonomy, what are 'Primates'?
qh: मानव विकास की कहानी में 'प्राइमेट्स' (Primates) क्या हैं?
o: A subgroup of placental mammals including prosimians, monkeys, apes, and humans
e: Primates mammals ka wo order hai jisme monkeys, apes aur humans shamil hain jinki grasping hands aur developed vision hoti hai.

qe: Where were the oldest fossil specimens of Australopithecus recovered?
qh: ऑस्ट्रेलोपिथेकस (Australopithecus) के सबसे पुराने जीवाश्म कहाँ मिले हैं?
e: Australopithecus ke oldest fossils East African Rift Valley (Olduvai Gorge, Hadar, Laetoli) se discover hue.

qe: Where were the fossilized archaic remains of 'Heidelberg Man' (Homo heidelbergensis) unearthed?
qh: हाइडेल्बर्ग मानव (Heidelberg Man) के अवशेष कहाँ खोजे गए थे?
e: Homo heidelbergensis ke remains Germany ke Heidelberg (Europe) se discover hue the.

qe: The earliest archaeological evidence for the controlled use of fire is linked to which human species?
qh: आग (Fire) के नियंत्रित उपयोग के सबसे पुराने प्रमाण किस मानव प्रजाति से जुड़े हैं?
e: Homo erectus ne hearths aur controlled fire use karke warmth, protection aur food cooking seekha tha.

qe: What is the specialized anthropological discipline that studies living contemporary ethnic communities?
qh: मानव विज्ञान की वह शाखा क्या कहलाती है जो समकालीन मानव समूहों का अध्ययन करती है?
e: Ethnography modern tribal aur hunter-gatherer communities ke cultural practices aur lifestyle ki analytical study karti hai.

qe: Who are the 'Hadza' documented by modern anthropologists?
qh: हद्ज़ा (Hadza) क्या है?
o: A contemporary hunter-gatherer indigenous community in East Africa
e: Hadza Tanzania (East Africa) me Lake Eyasi ke paas rehne wala traditional hunter-gatherer group hai.

qe: What does the 'Positive Feedback Mechanism' demonstrate in hominin physical evolution?
qh: पॉजिटिव फीडबैक मैकेनिज्म (Positive Feedback Mechanism) मानव विकास में क्या दर्शाता है?
o: How one evolutionary trait reinforces and accelerates another development
e: Bipedalism ne hands free kiye, free hands ne tool making badhayi, tool making ne brain develop kiya—ye chain mutual reinforcement (positive feedback) hai.

qe: What transformative economic revolution occurred in human culture roughly 10,000 years ago?
qh: लगभग 10,000 साल पहले मानव जीवन में सबसे बड़ा बदलाव क्या आया?
o: Adoption of Agriculture, Plant Cultivation, and Animal Domestication
e: Neolithic Revolution me humans ne hunting-gathering chhodkar agriculture aur livestock domestication shuru kiya.

qe: Where is the famous Paleolithic cave site of 'Altamira', renowned for polychrome animal murals, located?
qh: प्रारंभिक मानव के गुफा चित्रों के प्रसिद्ध उदाहरण 'अल्तमिरा' कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Altamira caves northern Spain me hain jahan prehistoric Upper Paleolithic bison paintings milti hain.

qe: What does the archaeological designation 'Proto-history' refer to?
qh: मानव विकास के क्रम में 'प्रोटो-हिस्ट्री' (Proto-history) से क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: Period for which written records exist but remain undeciphered
e: Proto-history wo period hai jiske written records exist karte hain par abhi tak decipher nahi ho sake hain (jaise Harappan script).

qe: What was the specialized 'Punch Blade Technique' used for in the Upper Paleolithic?
qh: पंच ब्लेड तकनीक (Punch Blade Technique) का उपयोग किस लिए किया जाता था?
o: Detaching thin, razor-sharp parallel-sided stone blades from a prepared core
e: Punch blade technique me bone/antler punch use karke stone core se thin, sharp blade tools nikale jaate the.

qe: What primary morphological distinctions separate Hominids from Hominoids?
qh: होमिनिड्स (Hominids) और होमिनॉयड्स (Hominoids) में मुख्य अंतर क्या है?
o: Hominids possess larger brains, upright posture, and bipedal locomotion
e: Hominids bipedal hote hain, sidhe khade ho sakte hain aur unka brain size hominoids (apes) se significantly bada hota hai.

qe: What was the initial primary incentive for early humans to domesticate animals?
qh: मानव द्वारा जानवरों को पालतू बनाने का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: Reliable on-demand food supply (meat, milk) and security
e: Hunting par dependency kam karne ke liye milk, meat aur guard support ke purpose se animals domesticate kiye gaye.

qe: At which archaeological site in Southern France were the post-hole remains of seasonal huts excavated at 'Terra Amata'?
qh: प्रारंभिक मानव के रहने के स्थान 'टेरा अमाटा' (Terra Amata) के अवशेष कहाँ मिले हैं?
e: Terra Amata Nice (France) me beachside site hai jahan early hominins ke banaye temporary wooden huts ke evidence mile.

qe: According to evolutionary linguistics, what was the earliest operational form of hominin communication?
qh: मानव विकास की कहानी के अनुसार सबसे पहले भाषा का रूप क्या रहा होगा?
o: Gestures, body language, and non-verbal hand signals
e: Spoken words aane se pehle hominins visual body gestures, hand movements aur non-verbal grunts se communicate karte the.

qe: How is a 'Fossil' scientifically defined in paleontology?
qh: फॉसिल (Fossil) क्या है?
o: The petrified remains or mineralized impressions of ancient organic life preserved in rock
e: Millions of years purane plants, animals ya human bones jo sedimentary rock strata me mineralize hokar stone ban jaate hain, Fossils kehlaate hain.

qe: Which continent is scientifically identified as the geographical cradle and origin point of Homo sapiens?
qh: होमो सेपियंस का मूल उत्पत्ति स्थान किसे माना जाता है?
e: Genetic aur fossil evidence confirm karte hain ki modern Homo sapiens lagbhag 300,000 saal pehle Africa me evolve hue aur wahan se migrate hue.

qe: What did early hominin 'Scavenging' behavior entail?
qh: प्रारंभिक मानव का 'स्कैवेंजिंग' (Scavenging) से क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: Foraging meat and bone marrow from carcasses left by apex carnivores or natural death
e: Early hominins predators ke maare hue ya naturally dead janwaron ke carcasses se bacha hua meat aur bone marrow gather karte the.

qe: What does Charles Darwin's concept of 'Natural Selection' posit regarding evolutionary adaptation?
qh: डार्विन के अनुसार मानव विकास में 'नेचुरल सिलेक्शन' (Natural Selection) क्या है?
o: Differential survival and reproductive success of organisms best adapted to their ecological niche
e: Environmental changes me wahi organisms survive aur reproduce karte hain jinki genetic traits environment ke anukul hoti hain (Survival of the fittest).

qe: Which monumental societal transformation materialized across river valleys roughly 5,000 years ago?
qh: लगभग 5,000 साल पहले मानव समाज में कौन सा बड़ा विकास हुआ?
o: Emergence of urban centers, statecraft, and pristine civilizations
e: Farming surplus ke baad 5000 saal pehle Bronze Age cities, centralized empires aur organized state systems (Mesopotamia, Harappa) emerge hue.

qe: What is the measured architectural height of the rustless Iron Pillar standing at Mehrauli, Delhi?
qh: दिल्ली के महरौली में स्थित लौह स्तंभ (Iron Pillar) की ऊंचाई कितनी है?
e: Mehrauli ka Iron Pillar lagbhag 7.2 meters uncha hai aur iska weight around 3 tonnes se zyada hai.

qe: Which ruler's name is inscribed in Brahmi script on the Mehrauli Iron Pillar?
qh: महरौली लौह स्तंभ पर खुदे हुए इनस्क्रिप्शन में किस राजा का नाम मिलता है?
e: Pillar par 'Chandra' naam ke ruler ka mention hai, jise historians Gupta Emperor Chandragupta II Vikramaditya identify karte hain.

qe: What is the literal Sanskrit translation and meaning of the Buddhist word 'Stupa'?
qh: स्तूप (Stupa) शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या होता है?
e: Sanskrit me Stupa ka literal meaning 'Mound' yaani dher/teela hota hai.

qe: What was the small container embedded at the core of a Stupa containing sacred bodily relics called?
qh: स्तूप के भीतर रखे गए उस छोटे डिब्बे को क्या कहते हैं जिसमें बुद्ध या उनके अनुयायियों के अवशेष रखे जाते थे?
e: Stupa ke center me 'Relic Casket' (Dhatu Manjusha) rakha jata tha jisme teeth, bone ya ash rakhi jaati thi.

qe: What is the circular ambulatory corridor laid around a Stupa for devotional circumambulation called?
qh: स्तूप के चारों ओर परिक्रमा करने के लिए बनाए गए वृत्ताकार पथ को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Stupa ke chaaro taraf clockwise circumambulation ke liye bane path ko Pradakshina Patha kehte hain.

qe: What is the inner sanctuary of an ancient Hindu temple housing the principal deity called?
qh: मंदिर के उस मुख्य भाग को क्या कहते हैं जहाँ मुख्य देवी या देवता की मूर्ति रखी जाती थी?
e: Garbhagriha temple ka central sanctum sanctorum hota hai jahan main deity ki murti install hoti hai.

qe: The ancient Gupta-era brick temple at Bhitargaon (Uttar Pradesh) was constructed using which material?
qh: उत्तर प्रदेश के भीतरगाँव का मंदिर लगभग 1500 साल पहले किस सामग्री से बनाया गया था?
e: Bhitargaon ka temple ancient India ke sabse purane surviving brick temples me se ek hai jo baked bricks se bana hai.

qe: What is the standout architectural characteristic of the Pallava rock temples at Mahabalipuram?
qh: महाबलीपुरम के मंदिरों की मुख्य विशेषता क्या है?
o: Monolithic structures carved out of singular granite boulders
e: Mahabalipuram ke rath temples Monolithic hain, yaani ek hi gigantic granite rock ko cut karke pure temple banaye gaye hain.

qe: Under what artificial illumination were the intricate mural frescoes inside the dark Ajanta caves executed?
qh: अजंता की गुफाओं में चित्रकारी मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकाश में की गई थी?
e: Ajanta caves ke andar natural daylight nahi thi, isliye artists ne torches aur brass reflectors ki light me paintings draw ki thi.

qe: Who composed the celebrated classic Tamil Sangam epic 'Silappadikaram'?
qh: तमिल महाकाव्य 'शिलप्पदिकारम' (Silappadikaram) की रचना किसने की थी?
e: Silappadikaram ki rachna Ilango Adigal ne lagbhag 1800 saal pehle ki thi.

qe: The epic 'Silappadikaram' narrates the tragic saga of which merchant and his chaste wife Kannagi?
qh: शिलप्पदिकारम महाकाव्य किस व्यापारी और उसकी पत्नी कण्णगी की कहानी है?
e: Ye Puhar ke merchant Kovalan aur uski loyal wife Kannagi ke anklet ki tragic love story hai.

qe: Who authored the famous sequel Tamil epic 'Manimekalai'?
qh: दूसरा प्रसिद्ध तमिल महाकाव्य 'मणिमेखलाई' (Manimekalai) किसके द्वारा लिखा गया था?
e: Manimekalai ko poet Chithalai Sathanar (Sattanar) ne likha tha, jo Kovalan aur Madhavi ki beti Manimekalai par based hai.

qe: In which classical language did Mahakavi Kalidasa compose his literary masterpieces?
qh: कालिदास ने अपनी प्रसिद्ध रचनाएं किस भाषा में लिखी थीं?
e: Kalidasa Gupta period ke court poet the aur unke saare plays aur poems classical Sanskrit me composed hain.

qe: What was the overarching cultural objective behind compiling the Hindu Puranas?
qh: पुराणों (Puranas) का संकलन मुख्य रूप से किस उद्देश्य के लिए किया गया था?
o: Preserving and disseminating devotional narratives of deities accessible to all
Restricting spiritual knowledge solely to kings
e: Puranas easy Sanskrit me compile kiye gaye the taaki women aur shudras samet sabhi log devi-devtaon ki stories sun sakein.

qe: Which legendary sage is traditionally credited with the compilation of both the Mahabharata and the Puranas?
qh: महाभारत और पुराणों दोनों का संकलन किसने किया था?
e: Tradition ke hisaab se sage Veda Vyasa ne Mahabharata aur Puranas ko compile kiya tha.

qe: Who is revered as the original composer of the epic Ramayana in classical Sanskrit?
qh: संस्कृत रामायण के रचयिता कौन माने जाते हैं?
e: Maharshi Valmiki ko original classical Sanskrit Ramayana ka author maana jata hai.

qe: In which folklore collections were the moral tales narrated by ordinary people preserved?
qh: आम लोगों द्वारा कही जाने वाली कहानियों का संग्रह किन पुस्तकों में मिलता है?
e: Aam janta ki moral stories aur animal fables ko Buddhist Jatakas aur Vishnu Sharma ke Panchatantra me preserve kiya gaya.

qe: Which pathbreaking astronomical treatise in Sanskrit was authored by Aryabhata?
qh: गणितज्ञ और खगोलशास्त्री आर्यभट्ट ने कौन सी पुस्तक लिखी थी?
e: Gupta era ke genius Aryabhata ne astronomy aur mathematics par 'Aryabhatiyam' treatise likhi thi.

qe: What scientific explanation did Aryabhata propose for the daily cycle of day and night?
qh: आर्यभट्ट ने दिन और रात होने का क्या कारण बताया था?
o: The physical orbit of the Sun around the Earth
The axial rotation of the Earth on its own axis
The shadow cast by the moon
e: Aryabhata ne explain kiya tha ki Sun stationary dikhta hai aur day-night Earth ke apne axis par rotate hone se hote hain.

qe: Who authored the foundational ancient Indian medical compendium 'Charaka Samhita'?
qh: प्राचीन भारत में चिकित्सा (Medicine) पर लिखी गई प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'चरक संहिता' के लेखक कौन हैं?
e: Maharshi Charaka Ayurveda ke master the jinhone internal medicine par 'Charaka Samhita' likhi.

qe: Who authored the 'Sushruta Samhita', celebrated for its descriptions of surgical instruments and procedures?
qh: शल्य चिकित्सा (Surgery) के विस्तृत विवरण वाली 'सुश्रुत संहिता' किसने लिखी थी?
e: Sushruta ko Father of Surgery kaha jata hai jinhone rhinoplasty aur cataract surgery ka details 'Sushruta Samhita' me diya.

qe: Scholars of which country invented the standalone positional numeral symbol for Zero?
qh: शून्य (Zero) के लिए विशेष चिह्न का आविष्कार किस देश के गणितज्ञों ने किया था?
e: India ke mathematicians ne zero ko as a separate number aur special symbol invent karke place-value system ko complete kiya.

qe: Which trading civilization adopted the Indian decimal-numeral system and introduced it to medieval Europe?
qh: भारतीय गणना पद्धति (Counting system) को अपनाकर इसे यूरोप तक किसने फैलाया?
e: Arabs ne Indian mathematical numerals aur zero ko adopt kiya jahan se ye Europe me 'Hindu-Arabic numerals' ban kar phaila.

qe: What was the purpose of a 'Mandapa' in classical temple architecture?
qh: मंदिरों में 'मंडप' (Mandapa) का क्या उपयोग होता था?
o: A congregational pillared hall where devotees could assemble
e: Mandapa temple ka wo pillared hall ya portico hota tha jahan devotees religious discourses aur rituals ke liye assemble hote the.

qe: In which lyrical poem of Kalidasa does an exiled lover send a message to his beloved via a cloud?
qh: कालिदास की प्रसिद्ध कविता जिसमें विरही प्रेमी के संदेश का वर्णन है, उसका नाम क्या है?
e: Meghaduta me ek Yaksha cloud ko messenger banakar Alakapuri me apni beloved ko message bhejta hai.

qe: What were sea cowries (Kaudis) predominantly utilized as in ancient Afro-Eurasian trade?
qh: प्राचीन काल में कौड़ियों (Cowries) का उपयोग किस रूप में किया जाता था?
e: Maldives se aane wali cowrie shells ancient time me international trade me reliable currency ki tarah use hoti thi.

qe: Which vast trans-continental land and maritime networks were interconnected by the historical Silk Route?
qh: सिल्क रूट (Silk Route) मुख्य रूप से किन क्षेत्रों को जोड़ता था?
e: Silk route Asia ke commercial hubs ko Europe aur North Africa se jodne wala overland aur maritime network tha.

qe: Who authored the Marathi travelogue 'Majha Pravas', documenting eyewitness accounts of the 1857 revolt?
qh: विष्णु भट्ट गोडसे द्वारा लिखित पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
o: Poverty and Un-British Rule in India
e: Vishnu Bhatt Godse ne 'Majha Pravas' likhi thi jisme 1857 revolt ke dauran Jhansi aur North India ke eyewitness accounts hain.

qe: What technological marvel of the Mehrauli Iron Pillar continues to perplex modern metallurgists?
qh: दिल्ली के महरौली में स्थित 'लौह स्तंभ' (Iron Pillar) की सबसे बड़ी विशेषता क्या है, जो वैज्ञानिकों को आज भी आश्चर्यचकित करती है?
o: Complete absence of rust and corrosion after 1500 years of open-air exposure
e: 1500 saal se open sky me khada rehne ke baad bhi Mehrauli Iron Pillar par passive rust layer (misawite) ki wajah se jung nahi laga.

qe: The monumental superstructure erected vertically over the Garbhagriha to signify its sanctity is termed:
qh: गर्भ गृह के ऊपर काफी ऊँचाई तक बनाए जाने वाले ढांचे को क्या कहते हैं?
e: North Indian temple architecture me Garbhagriha ke theek upar banaye gaye tall tapering tower ko Shikhara kehte hain.

qe: What important epigraphic pillar inscription composed by court poet Harishena records the conquests of Samudragupta?
qh: प्रसिद्ध गुप्त शासक समुद्रगुप्त के बारे में जानकारी किस महत्वपूर्ण शिलालेख से मिलती है?
e: Allahabad Ashokan pillar par Harishena dwara sanskrit me likhi Prayag Prashasti se Samudragupta ki victories ka pata chalta hai.

qe: Who was the royal court poet and minister who composed the Sanskrit eulogy known as the Prayag Prashasti?
qh: समुद्रगुप्त के दरबारी कवि और मंत्री कौन थे, जिन्होंने प्रयाग प्रशस्ति की रचना की थी?
e: Harishena Samudragupta ke Mahadandanayaka aur court poet the jinhone chaste Sanskrit me Prayag Prashasti compose ki.

qe: According to the Prayag Prashasti, how many rulers of Aryavarta did Samudragupta uproot and annex?
qh: प्रयाग प्रशस्ति के अनुसार, समुद्रगुप्त ने आर्यावर्त के कुल कितने शासकों को हराकर उनके राज्यों को अपने साम्राज्य में मिला लिया था?
e: Samudragupta ne Aryavarta (Northern India) ke 9 kings ko defeat karke unke kingdoms ko directly Gupta empire me merge kiya.

qe: How many southern rulers of Dakshinapatha surrendered to Samudragupta and were reinstated as tributary vassals?
qh: दक्षिणपंथ के कितने शासकों ने हारने के बाद समुद्रगुप्त के सामने आत्मसमर्पण किया और बाद में उन्हें फिर से शासन करने की अनुमति दी गई?
e: Samudragupta ne Dakshinapatha ke 12 rulers ko capture karke chhod diya (Grahana-Mokshanugraha policy) aur tributary banaya.

qe: Who was the first imperial Gupta monarch to assume the grandiose sovereign title of 'Maharajadhiraja'?
qh: गुप्त वंश के किस शासक ने सबसे पहले 'महाराजाधिराज' जैसी बड़ी उपाधि धारण की थी?
e: Chandragupta I pehle Gupta ruler the jinhone Lichchhavi princess Kumaradevi se marriage ke baad 'Maharajadhiraja' title adopt kiya.

qe: To which ancient clan or Gana did Kumaradevi, the royal mother of Emperor Samudragupta, belong?
qh: समुद्रगुप्त की माँ, कुमारदेवी, किस गण या वंश से संबंधित थीं?
e: Kumaradevi prestigious Licchavi clan ki princess thi, isliye Samudragupta ko coins par 'Licchavi-dauhitra' likha gaya.

qe: Which musical instrument is Emperor Samudragupta depicted playing on his gold numismatic issues?
qh: सिक्कों पर वीणा बजाते हुए किस गुप्त राजा को दिखाया गया है?
e: Samudragupta ke gold coins par unhe couch par baithkar Veena play karte hue dikhaya gaya hai, jo unka music talent darshata hai.

qe: Which Gupta ruler adopted the imperial title 'Vikramaditya' after defeating the Western Kshatrapa Shakas?
qh: शकों पर विजय के प्रतीक के रूप में 'विक्रमादित्य' की उपाधि किसने धारण की थी?
e: Chandragupta II ne Western India se Shaka rulers ko eradicate karke 'Vikramaditya' aur 'Sakari' title liya.

qe: Who was the court poet who authored the biography 'Harshacharita' praising King Harshavardhana?
qh: हर्षवर्धन के दरबारी कवि कौन थे, जिन्होंने उनकी जीवनी 'हर्षचरित' लिखी थी?
e: Banabhatta ne Sanskrit me Harshavardhana ki early life aur deeds par 'Harshacharita' likhi thi.

qe: Which Chalukya sovereign checked the southward imperial expansion of Harshavardhana on the banks of the Narmada?
qh: हर्षवर्धन को दक्षिण की ओर बढ़ने से किस चालुक्य राजा ने नर्मदा नदी के तट पर रोका था?
e: Chalukya king Pulakeshin II ne Narmada nadi ke kinare Harshavardhana ko defeat karke unka south expansion halt kar diya.

qe: Who composed the celebrated Aihole stone Prashasti detailing the military feats of Chalukya King Pulakeshin II?
qh: पुलकेशिन द्वितीय के बारे में जानकारी उनके दरबारी कवि द्वारा रचित प्रशस्ति से मिलती है, उनका नाम क्या था?
e: Jain poet Ravikirti ne Aihole inscription compose kiya tha jisme Pulakeshin II ki Harsha par victory ka description hai.

qe: What was the capital of the Pallava dynasty situated near the fertile Kaveri delta?
qh: पल्लव राजाओं की राजधानी कहाँ स्थित थी?
e: Pallavas ki capital Kanchipuram thi, jo religious aur temple architecture ka bohot bada center bani.

qe: Which vibrant commercial trading center and temple town served as an early capital of the Chalukyas?
qh: चालुक्यों का मुख्य व्यापारिक और सांस्कृतिक केंद्र कौन सा था, जो उनकी राजधानी भी थी?
e: Aihole Chalukyas ka early commercial trading hub aur temple architecture ka lab tha jise baad me Badami move kiya gaya.

qe: In the administrative hierarchy of the Gupta Empire, what was the portfolio of a 'Mahadandanayaka'?
qh: गुप्त काल में 'महादंडनायक' पद का क्या अर्थ था?
e: Mahadandanayaka ka post Chief Judicial Officer aur high-ranking judicial-military authority ka hota tha.

qe: What did the high-ranking administrative title 'Kumara-amatya' signify during the Gupta era?
qh: गुप्त और उत्तर-गुप्त काल में 'कुमार-अमात्य' का पद किसे दिया जाता था?
e: Kumara-amatya central administration me high executive officer aur versatile minister rank hoti thi.

qe: In the administrative terminology of southern kingdoms, what was a 'Sabha'?
qh: दक्षिण के राज्यों में 'सभा' किसे कहा जाता था?
e: Pallava records me Sabha un villages ki assembly hoti thi jahan land Brahmin proprietors (Brahmadeya) ke paas thi.

qe: Kalidasa's masterwork drama 'Abhigyana Shakuntalam' dramatizes the romance of Shakuntala with which king?
qh: कालिदास का सबसे प्रसिद्ध नाटक 'अभिज्ञान शाकुन्तलम' किनके बीच की प्रेम कहानी है?
e: Abhigyana Shakuntalam Hastinapur ke King Dushyanta aur Kanva rishi ki ashram-kanya Shakuntala ki prem katha hai.

qe: The Chinese Buddhist pilgrim Faxian highlighted the harsh social ostracization faced by which community in India?
qh: चीनी तीर्थयात्री 'फ़ाह्यान' ने किन लोगों की दुर्दशा का वर्णन किया है, जिन्हें शहर के बाहर रहना पड़ता था?
e: Faxian ne note kiya ki Chandalas ko shahar se bahar rehna padta tha aur shahar me aate waqt wood click karke sound karna padta tha.

qe: In the municipal guilds of the Gupta period, who was designated as the 'Sarthavaha'?
qh: गुप्त काल के प्रशासन में 'सार्थवाह' (Sarthavaha) किसे कहा जाता था?
o: Leader of the traveling merchant caravans
e: Sarthavaha long-distance trading caravan ke leader aur guide ko kaha jata tha jo town administrative boards me bhi rehte the.

qe: Which Chinese pilgrim spent extensive years studying and recording the court of Harshavardhana?
qh: हर्षवर्धन के शासनकाल में कौन सा प्रसिद्ध चीनी यात्री भारत आया था?
e: Xuanzang Harsha ke reign me India aaye the aur unhone Kannauj assembly aur Nalanda University ka vivid account diya.

qe: What was the village headman called in the northern agrarian plains during the post-Mauryan and Gupta periods?
qh: मौर्योत्तर काल में भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप के उत्तरी भाग में गाँव के प्रधान व्यक्ति को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: North India me gaon ka hereditary chief Gramabhojaka kehlata tha jo village ka sabse bada landowner aur tax collector hota tha.

qe: In ancient Tamil Sangam terminology, what were large prosperous landowners called?
qh: तमिल क्षेत्र में बड़े भूस्वामियों को प्राचीन काल में किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: Sangam society me rich aur influential land-owning class ko Vellalar kaha jata tha.

qe: In ancient South India, which socio-economic class was designated by the term 'Adimai'?
qh: प्राचीन काल में 'अदिमई' (Adimai) शब्द का प्रयोग किनके लिए किया जाता था?
e: Tamilakam me landless labourers ko Kadaisiyar aur household slaves ko Adimai kaha jata tha.

qe: What were small independent freeholding farmers referred to as in Northern India?
qh: उत्तर भारत में स्वतंत्र छोटे किसानों को क्या कहा जाता था, जिनके पास अपनी कम भूमि होती थी?
e: Chhote independent farmers jinke paas apni land hoti thi unhe North India me Grihapatis kaha jata tha.

qe: In which city were the famous literary academies (Sangams) of ancient Tamil poets organized?
qh: संगम साहित्य की रचना और संकलन किस शहर की सभाओं (Sangams) में किया गया था?
e: Pandya kings ke patronage me Tamil poets ki assembly (Sangam) Madurai me organize hui thi.

qe: What civic purpose was served by the ceramic 'Ring Wells' uncovered in early historical urban centers?
qh: पुरातत्वविदों को खुदाई में 'वलय कूप' (Ring Wells) मिले हैं, इनका मुख्य उपयोग क्या था?
o: Domestic soak pits, drains, and latrines
e: Ring wells ceramic rings ko stack karke banaye jaate the jo domestic soak-pits, drains ya latrines ki tarah use hote the.

qe: Mathura functioned as the prosperous second capital of which Central Asian imperial dynasty?
qh: प्राचीन व्यापारिक मार्गों के संगम पर स्थित 'मथुरा' किस वंश की दूसरी राजधानी बनी थी?
e: Kushana empire ki primary capital Purushapura (Peshawar) thi aur second capital Mathura thi.

qe: How were ancient Indian 'Punch-Marked Coins' (Aahat coins) typically manufactured?
qh: आहत सिक्के (Punch Marked Coins) सामान्यतः किस आकार के होते थे और उन्हें कैसे बनाया जाता था?
o: Punching geometric/natural symbols on cut silver/copper metal flans
e: Metal sheets ko cut karke punches se symbols (tree, sun, hill) impress karke Aahat (Punch-marked) coins banaye jaate the.

qe: What were the mercantile and artisan guilds known as during the early historical urban period?
qh: शिल्पकारों और व्यापारियों द्वारा बनाए गए संगठनों को प्राचीन काल में क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Artisans aur merchants ke economic associations ko Shrenis kehte the jo training, production aur banks ka kaam karti thi.

qe: The exquisite, lustrous pottery known as 'Northern Black Polished Ware' (NBPW) belongs to which historical era?
qh: उत्तर भारत में पाए जाने वाले 'उत्तरी काले चमकीले पात्र' (NBPW) किस काल की प्रमुख विशेषता हैं?
e: NBPW high-quality glossy black luxury pottery thi jo second urbanization (Mahajanapada aur Mauryan era) me flourish hui.

qe: What was the prominent historical identity of 'Arikamedu' located near Puducherry?
qh: पुडुचेरी में स्थित 'अरिकामेडु' (Arikamedu) प्राचीन काल में किस रूप में प्रसिद्ध था?
e: Arikamedu Coromandel coast par Indo-Roman trade ka major coastal port tha jahan ships aakar unload hoti thi.

qe: Which foreign Roman luxury wares were unearthed during excavations at Arikamedu?
qh: अरिकामेडु से किस विदेशी सभ्यता के अवशेष जैसे 'एमफोरा' और 'एरेटाइन' पात्र मिले हैं?
o: Roman Amphorae and stamped Arretine pottery
e: Arikamedu se Roman wine containers (Amphorae) aur Italy ke Arezzo me bani stamped Arretine pottery mili hai.

qe: Which prized South Indian spice was termed 'Black Gold' in the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन अंपायर में भारत के किस मसाले की इतनी माँग थी कि उसे 'काला सोना' (Black Gold) कहा जाता था?
e: Roman Empire me Indian Black Pepper (kali mirch) ki demand bohot high thi, isliye use 'Black Gold' (Yavanapriya) kaha gaya.

qe: What political title does Sangam literature use to denote the three crowned dynasties (Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas)?
qh: दक्षिण भारत के तीन शासक परिवारों - चोल, चेर और पाण्ड्य के लिए संगम साहित्य में किस शब्द का प्रयोग किया गया है?
e: Tamil word 'Muvendar' ka matlab 'Three Chiefs' hota hai jo Chola, Chera aur Pandya rulers ke liye use hua hai.

qe: Which prosperous cultural city served as the historic royal capital of the Pandyas?
qh: पाण्ड्य शासकों की राजधानी कहाँ स्थित थी?
e: Madurai Vaigai nadi ke kinare Pandya kings ki capital aur pearl trade ka main center tha.

qe: Who is celebrated as the greatest ruler of the Deccan-based Satavahana dynasty?
qh: पश्चिमी भारत में सातवाहन वंश का सबसे प्रमुख राजा कौन था?
e: Gautamiputra Shri Satakarni ne Shakas ko defeat karke Satavahana power ko restore kiya tha.

qe: By what grand sovereign title were the Satavahana kings known in ancient inscriptions?
qh: सातवाहन शासकों को निम्नलिखित में से किस उपाधि से जाना जाता था?
e: Satavahana rulers south-bound trade routes ko control karte the, isliye unhe 'Dakshinapatha-pati' (Lords of Dakshinapatha) kaha gaya.

qe: Which powerful dynasty gained paramount control over the strategic northern branches of the Silk Route?
qh: प्राचीन व्यापार के संदर्भ में 'सिल्क रूट' (Silk Route) पर नियंत्रण रखने वाले सबसे प्रसिद्ध शासक कौन थे?
e: Kushanas ne Central Asia se North India tak faili Silk Route ko control kiya aur heavy trade taxes collect kiye.

qe: Who founded the Mauryan Empire around 321 BCE with the strategic guidance of Chanakya?
qh: मौर्य साम्राज्य की स्थापना लगभग 2300 साल पहले किसने की थी?
e: Chandragupta Maurya ne Chanakya ki madad se Nanda dynasty ko overthrow karke Mauryan Empire establish kiya.

qe: What is the title of the statecraft manual compiled by Chanakya (Kautilya)?
qh: चाणक्य (कौटिल्य) द्वारा लिखित प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
e: Kautilya ne state governance, economic policy aur diplomacy par comprehensive treatise 'Arthashastra' likha.

qe: Which Greek ambassador was stationed by Seleucus I Nicator at the court of Chandragupta Maurya?
qh: यूनानी राजा सेल्यूकस निकेटर ने चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य के दरबार में किस राजदूत को भेजा था?
e: Megasthenes Seleucid ambassador the jinhone Mauryan administration aur society par apni book 'Indica' likhi.

qe: Following the devastation of which war did Emperor Ashoka renounce conquest by war for conquest by Dhamma?
qh: सम्राट अशोक ने किस युद्ध के बाद हिंसा का त्याग कर 'धम्म' का मार्ग अपनाया था?
e: Kalinga war me hue massive carnage aur bloodshed ko dekhkar Ashoka ne bherighosha ko dhammaghosha me convert kiya.

qe: In which language and script were the majority of Ashoka's public royal edicts issued?
qh: अशोक के अधिकतर अभिलेख किस भाषा और लिपि में लिखे गए हैं?
e: Ashoka ke major rock edicts aam janta ki bhasha Prakrit me aur Brahmi script me engraved the.

qe: What special cadre of officials was commissioned by Ashoka to inculcate ethical principles of Dhamma?
qh: अशोक ने अपने 'धम्म' के संदेश को फैलाने के लिए किन अधिकारियों की नियुक्ति की थी?
e: Ashoka ne 'Dhamma Mahamatta' namak special moral officers appoint kiye jo society me Dhamma propagate karte the.

qe: The ancient province of Kalinga conquered by Ashoka forms part of which modern Indian state?
qh: अशोक का कलिंग (Kalinga) क्षेत्र वर्तमान में किस भारतीय राज्य का हिस्सा है?
e: Ancient Kalinga coastal Odisha aur northern Andhra Pradesh ke geographical belt ko represent karta hai.

qe: Which Mauryan emperor erected the Lion Capital at Sarnath, adopted as the National Emblem of India?
qh: सारनाथ में स्थित चार शेरों वाला स्तंभ शीर्ष (Lion Capital) किस सम्राट द्वारा बनवाया गया था?
e: Emperor Ashoka ne Buddha ke first sermon ki memory me Sarnath me four-lion capital pillar banwaya tha.

qe: In the Mauryan administrative framework, what distinguished 'Tribute' (Nazrana) from regular 'Taxes' (Kara)?
qh: मौर्य शासन के दौरान 'नज़राना' (Tribute) और 'कर' (Tax) में क्या अंतर था?
o: Taxes were voluntary gifts, while tribute was mandatory
Taxes were collected on a regular basis, while tribute was collected irregularly when possible
Both terms were identical in revenue codes
Tribute was collected exclusively in coinage
e: Taxes regular revenue assessments the, jabki Tribute variety of commodities ke form me irregularly collect hota tha.

qe: According to Megasthenes, in what ceremonial vehicle was the Mauryan Emperor borne during royal public appearances?
qh: मेगास्थनीज के अनुसार, सम्राट के सार्वजनिक रूप से आने पर उन्हें किस प्रकार के पालकी में ले जाया जाता था?
e: Megasthenes ne note kiya ki royal public processions me Mauryan emperor ko ornamented Golden Palanquin me carry kiya jata tha.

qe: The city of Taxila stood as the strategic gateway to which territorial quarter of the Mauryan realm?
qh: तक्षशिला मौर्य साम्राज्य के किस दिशा का केंद्र या गेटवे (Gateway) था?
e: Taxila northwestern trade routes aur Central Asia ke transit corridor par positioned gateway city thi.

qe: Which of the following practices was strictly NOT an element of Emperor Ashoka's moral Dhamma?
qh: अशोक के 'धम्म' में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी बात शामिल नहीं थी?
o: Mandatory animal sacrifice and complex rituals to appease gods
Compassionate treatment of servants and prisoners
e: Ashoka ke Dhamma me rituals, yajnas aur animal sacrifice ko reject kiya gaya tha aur ethical conduct par stress tha.

qe: Which Hellenistic royal lineages consolidated power over Northwest India following the retreat of the Mauryas?
qh: मौर्य साम्राज्य के पतन के बाद लगभग 2000 साल पहले उत्तर-पश्चिम में किन राजाओं का शासन स्थापित हुआ?
e: Mauryan decline ke baad northwest me Indo-Greeks (Bactrian Greeks) ne coins aur administrative kingdoms set up kiye.

qe: Which children of Ashoka were sent to Sri Lanka to propagate the Buddhist teachings?
qh: अशोक ने अपने धम्म का संदेश सीरिया और मिस्र जैसे विदेशों में भी भेजा था, इसमें उनका पुत्र और पुत्री कौन थे?
e: Ashoka ne apne son Mahendra aur daughter Sanghamitra ko Bodhi tree ki branch ke sath Sri Lanka bheja tha.

qe: Under Mauryan imperial governance, which territory was under the immediate, direct administration of the Emperor?
qh: मौर्य प्रशासन में पाटलिपुत्र के आस-पास के क्षेत्र पर किसका सीधा नियंत्रण होता था?
e: Imperial capital Pataliputra aur surrounding core territory direct central emperor ke control me hoti thi.

qe: What forest resources were tribal forest dwellers expected to render to Mauryan officials?
qh: मौर्य काल में जंगलों में रहने वाले लोगों से क्या उम्मीद की जाती थी?
e: Forest tribes state ko war elephants, timber, raw honey aur wax provide karte the as customary tribute.

qe: To which warrior clan (Gana) did Siddhartha Gautama belong prior to renouncing his princely life?
qh: गौतम बुद्ध का संबंध किस गण (Clan) से था?
e: Gautama Buddha Kapilavastu ke Sakya kshatriya clan se belong karte the, isliye unhe 'Shakyamuni' bhi kehte hain.

qe: In Buddhist philosophical doctrine, what does the term 'Tanha' denote as the root cause of human suffering?
qh: बुद्ध की शिक्षाओं के अनुसार 'तन्हा' (तृष्णा) का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Buddha ne explain kiya ki unending desires aur cravings ('Tanha') hi manushya ke saare dukkha ka mool karan hai.

qe: In which vernacular dialect did Gautama Buddha preach so that ordinary masses could comprehend his teachings?
qh: बुद्ध ने अपनी शिक्षाएँ सामान्य लोगों को किस भाषा में दी थीं?
e: Elite Sanskrit ke bajay Buddha ne aam janta ki spoken dialect Prakrit (Magadhi Prakrit) me preach kiya.

qe: What fundamental universal truth was taught by Gautama Buddha through the parable of Kisa Gotami?
qh: किसा गौतमी की कहानी बुद्ध ने क्या सिखाने के लिए सुनाई थी?
o: The universality and inevitability of death for all living beings
e: Mustard seed mangwa kar Buddha ne Kisa Gotami ko sikhaya ki mrityu har ghar me hoti hai aur death sabke liye unavoidable hai.

qe: What did the Upanishadic seers deduce regarding the ultimate identity of 'Atman' and 'Brahman'?
qh: उपनिषदों के विचारकों का मानना था कि अंततः 'आत्मा' और 'ब्रह्म' क्या हैं?
o: Ultimately identical and one with the universal soul
e: Upanishads ka core philosophy 'Aham Brahmasmi' aur 'Tat Tvam Asi' hai—individual soul (Atman) aur universal soul (Brahman) ek hi hain.

qe: Who was Gargi Vachaknavi, highlighted in the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad?
qh: प्रसिद्ध उपनिषद विचारक 'गार्गी' कौन थीं?
o: A renowned woman philosopher who debated sage Yajnavalkya
e: Gargi ek highly learned lady scholar thi jinhone King Janaka ke court me sage Yajnavalkya ke sath philosophical debate kiya tha.

qe: What uncompromising interpretation of 'Ahimsa' was mandated for Jain practitioners?
qh: जैन धर्म के अनुयायियों के लिए 'अहिंसा' का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Absolute non-injury and preservation of all forms of living organisms
e: Jainism me Ahimsa absolute hai; microscopic organisms, insects aur plants samet kisi bhi living being ko anjaane me bhi hurt nahi karna chahiye.

qe: Why did the rigid monastic rules of Jainism find greater adherence among mercantile traders than agrarian peasants?
qh: जैन धर्म को मुख्य रूप से किस वर्ग का समर्थन प्राप्त था?
o: Peasants could not afford white robes
Farming inevitably involved ploughing and killing crop-damaging insects and pests
